title: CDN Cache-Header Plan
description: A structured cache-header plan for one response class, so cdn-cache-control-headers' Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/cdn_cache_headers_audit.mjs.

responseKind.description: The response class, per the canonical-recipes table in SKILL.md.

cacheability.description: The storage directive: public (any cache), private (browser only), no-store (nothing), no-cache (store but always revalidate).

maxAge.description: max-age in seconds (browser + shared caches unless s-maxage overrides).

sMaxage.description: s-maxage in seconds — shared caches only; overrides max-age there per RFC 9111.

immutable.description: True if the immutable extension (RFC 8246) is set, skipping revalidation entirely.

staleWhileRevalidate.description: stale-while-revalidate window in seconds (RFC 5861): serve stale instantly while refreshing in the background.

staleIfError.description: stale-if-error window in seconds (RFC 5861): serve stale on origin 5xx.

varyHeaders.description: Request headers named in Vary. user-agent and cookie are hit-rate killers.

setCookiePresent.description: True if the response carries Set-Cookie — most CDNs decline to cache such responses.

mutableContent.description: True if the content changes after publish (edited articles, updated listings).

purgeOnEdit.description: True if origin edit events trigger a purge (surrogate-key or URL) so long TTLs stay safe.

surrogateKeysUsed.description: True if Surrogate-Key / Cache-Tag headers enable tag-based purging.

surrogateKeyCount.description: Number of surrogate keys/tags on this response. Cloudflare caps at 16, Fastly ~20.

expiresHeaderAlsoSet.description: True if a legacy Expires header is set alongside Cache-Control — conflicting signals.
